# MoYoung Glasses Android SDK

CyanBridge uses `moyoung_glasses_sdk_0.0.7_20260624.aar` only for devices using the
MoYoung/W620 protocol. The binary is distributed in the published
`moyoung_glasses_ble_plugin` 1.3.6 package.

- Source package: https://pub.dev/packages/moyoung_glasses_ble_plugin/versions/1.3.6
- Upstream repository: https://github.com/liangqian609/moyoung_glasses_ble_plugin
- Published archive SHA-256: `4d2aaf0360c64af6b67f959460fff6bda808de207c27cd775961841f9be22dc3`
- AAR SHA-256: `6aae64435aaa10b7c6b63b2783068d5de23b443f00636e2cd3903142472c0c86`

The upstream package declares GPL-3.0. Its license text is included in `LICENSE`.
